mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Empirically used in developmental and epileptic encephalopathies for seizure control (partial benefit); a WWOX-specific rationale is unresolved. Not deep recovery. Track B: no allele-specific datum; the single null-genotype report is n = 1 and not a refutation for a protein-retaining allele.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: The existing minimal falsifier of HYP-20260709-01: Seahorse OCR/ECAR on donor-derived cells or the existing organoids; this card adds no new endpoint.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: The ketogenic diet in WWOX-DEE: tried in 3 patients in one cohort and continued in 1; a null-genotype report where it was suspended. The Lucas-Clarke study contains no diet, ketone, PDH or pyruvate arm.
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: n of 3 and n of 1 clinical reports; fly lactate is amyloid-conditional.

cellular_context.limits: No metabolic readout of the lever exists in a WWOX-deficient human neural system; the lactate rows have opposite signs in the fly (with and without amyloid) and in one human MRS report.

p4_card.identity: Ketogenic diet (HYP-20260709-01, map record R-05) and, as a direction control only, MCT1 blockade (AZD3965 in DGIdb). No new compound.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: A decision for the treating clinical team, not for this system; this card only records the consequence of the Lucas-Clarke reading: no direct support and no refutation.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NOT NEW: existing hypothesis, updated with a consequence note on 2026-10-26.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: HYP-20260709-01 (ranked, proposed-to-L9), R-05, DL-MECH-020, DL-BIO-008, DL-BIO-009.
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN beyond the empirical seizure-control use.

external_not_wwox_evidence: DGIdb SLC16A1 rows: AZD3965 (inhibitor), valproic acid and sodium butyrate (no action type)

evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: The fly lactate result is conditional on amyloid and cannot be used for or against the Warburg direction in WWOX-null neurons.

p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: No independent replication of any fly row is held; the organoid rows are one laboratory's deposit.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: Disease-side fly rows carry verbatim locators in the manifest (104 entries; entries 31, 49, 89, 94 SUPPORTED by a blind audit, entry 95 narrowed after an OVERSHOOT finding); the compound statements are abstract-level and unaudited.
scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: Statements marked INFERENZA, including every statement about what a compound would do in WWOX-deficient tissue, are OWED a blind audit by another actor.

p4_card.next_measurement: Seahorse OCR/ECAR on donor-derived WWOX-deficient cells (or the existing knockout organoids), as already specified in HYP-20260709-01.
p4_card.value_added: Records that this paper changes nothing for the ketogenic hypothesis and names the one measurement that still decides it.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried.
directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
Every disease-side row from the Drosophila article is NOT WWOX-DEE EVIDENCE; the organoid rows are exploratory transcript analyses of one deposit.
Abstract-level statements from PubMed are labelled abstract_only; none carries a receipt.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED in the bridge: the bridge has no network. The openFDA adapter was run separately and is recorded in lucas_clarke_followup_20261026/compounds_and_sources.md.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; assay concentrations of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
no_new_reading: No paper was newly read in full for these cards. The Lucas-Clarke reading is scientist-a's (receipt FTR-20261026-42909904-01); the compound statements are abstract-level PubMed reads and registry-database retrievals (lucas_clarke_followup_20261026/).

abstention_card.missing_datum: A bioenergetic flux measurement (oxygen consumption and extracellular acidification) in WWOX-deficient versus isogenic human neural or donor-derived cells; never done in any WWOX human system (HYP-20260709-01, recalibration of 2026-09-21).
abstention_card.search_record: Lucas-Clarke 2026 read in full (receipt FTR-20261026-42909904-01): no diet, ketone, PDH or pyruvate arm. Six database sources and ten PubMed abstracts on 2026-10-26 added no WWOX ketone datum. Reopening condition: a flux measurement in a WWOX human system, or the pyruvate rows of MTBLS12344 if released.
